America's skies are reopening after a 4 hour, 22 minute nationwide ground stop, the longest since 9/11 as far as we can find.

Our estimate: about 633,000 travelers were grounded. At the low point, just 336 planes were in the air over the lower 48, down from 4,266 when it https://t.co/nyB93iVczx

Last Friday at 7:25 PM ET, 2,571 passenger planes were in the air over the lower 48. Tonight at the same minute: 143.

It's the longest nationwide ground stop since 9/11. The only other one, in 2023, was over in under 2 hours.

The ground stop is still in place. https://t.co/hoA9ZExFtt

An estimated 352,000 travelers are stuck on the ground right now.

About 3,200 passenger flights that would normally have left by now haven't. The FAA says flights will start leaving as its control centers recover.

The ground stop is still in place. We're watching it. https://t.co/Va5Zns8q0A
